Mamata Banerjee claims 'house arrest' amid security deployment

West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee alleged she was placed under 'house arrest' by police. This claim was made as security forces were heavily deployed outside her Kolkata residence, preventing her from visiting Baruipur to meet a victim's family. The deployment occurred ahead of her planned visit.
